protocol_correction_reason: The first classification pilot accidentally inherited the shorter regression schedule. This frozen rerun restores the established Adult protocol's batch size, epoch budget, and patience before confirmation.
hypothesis: The frozen T-PLE anchor plus zero-start Q/midrank residual transfers from temporal regression to binary classification without sacrificing validation log-loss.
safe_selection: epoch zero is the frozen T-PLE anchor and remains eligible for validation early stopping
pilot_gate: nonnegative validation log-loss gain in all 9 cells, strict wins in at least 5/9, positive mean validation gain, and positive mean test gain on at least 2/3 datasets
claim_boundary: Improvement over the internal parameter-matched T-PLE anchor is distinct from improvement over Adult's atom-aware exact-support model.
